meta.name: gstack-plan-ceo-review
meta.description: GStack CEO/founder-mode plan review for strategy, customer value, scope, sequencing, business risk, and whether the work should be done now.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从战略和商业角度评审产品计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是创始人或CEO,需要从商业视角审视产品路线图。
copy.tagline_en: Review product plans from a strategic and business perspective
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a founder or CEO needing to evaluate product roadmaps from a business perspective.

howto.what: Claude 会以 CEO/创始人视角审查计划，评估战略、客户价值、范围、排序、业务风险，并给出是否应立即执行的意见。
howto.when: 当计划的范围或排序不确定、需要检验客户价值或业务逻辑、或你明确要求“$gstack-plan-ceo-review”时触发。

say.text: 帮我用CEO视角审查这个产品路线图。
say.note: Claude 会输出战略风险列表和建议。

say.text: 这个功能现在该做吗？从创始人角度分析。
say.note: Claude 会给出是否立即执行的推荐。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews plans in CEO/founder mode, assessing strategy, customer value, scope, sequencing, business risk, and whether the work should be done now.
howto.when_en: Triggered when scope or sequencing is uncertain, customer value or business logic needs testing, or you explicitly invoke "$gstack-plan-ceo-review".

say_en.text: Review this product roadmap from a CEO perspective.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a strategic risk list and recommendation.

say_en.text: Should we build this feature now? Analyze as a founder.
say_en.note: Claude gives a do-now vs defer recommendation.
